name: night-living-room-hoodie-selfie

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic night living-room mirror selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult brunette woman with high ponytail and hazel eyes, wearing a full-length black hoodie and opaque black lounge pants, holding a smartphone with a small relaxed smile.
prompt.composition_elements: One arm holds phone, other hand rests naturally on the hoodie, couch, warm lamp, dark window, quiet apartment, and soft reflection. No lifted hem or underwear visibility.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm lamp glow against a dark window, slight iPhone noise, calm private apartment mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 9:16, 24mm look, natural skin texture, subtle grain, realistic exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult brunette woman with high ponytail and hazel eyes takes a night living-room mirror selfie wearing a full-length black hoodie and opaque black lounge pants. Include couch, warm lamp, dark window, quiet apartment, soft reflection, and slight iPhone noise. Keep the pose relaxed and fully covered.
